payload.core_mechanism_summary: Construct a 2x3 matrix using a large power of two (2^17) and XOR to make a greedy DP that always picks max AND deviate from the true optimal path by exactly k.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly uses XOR with 2^17 to craft values that cause the DP algorithm to fail by the given k. This is a classic bit manipulation trick relying on XOR to toggle bits and mislead the greedy DP.
